questions: The place (NOT SO [here]): does any narration of play put the characters at another settlement than the record's without a journey's move? How many [here] re-asks were made, at which steps, and did each second draft hold?
A comm voice: when someone is heard over a comm, does the fact block put them under "remote" rather than "present", and does the record keep their whereabouts where they were?
The journey offered: when a [here] re-ask fires on a paced line, does its card offer Set a Course for that place, and do the characters then get there by a journey's move?
Second person: does any beat of play name the character outside quoted speech, and how many [person] re-asks were made?
The vow: when "Find who is raiding the Cinder Expanse lanes" is fulfilled, does the narration name the one behind it — the plan's own name, or one drawn from the name oracle?
The sheet's meters: does any narrator truth the run recorded tell a character's health, spirit, supply or momentum changing?
Offers: when an offer's Roll is pressed, is the player's line posted once only, and does the roll's narration go on from the offer's beat without telling it again?
Worn details: what does DETAILS ALREADY WORN list, and how does the refrain count — words and phrases in a third or more of a session's narrations — compare with round 7's 39?
What it cost: the re-asks' calls, dollars and seconds a line against round 7 (332 calls, $2.85, a line's reply p50 8.3 s), and beats done, checks violated and memory recalled against round 7.

Arrivals: on each journey's arrival, who is in person at the destination, and does the record have them there, aboard, or at another place? (Two first-session re-records had the Hollow Spire dockmaster waiting at every destination before the ship; NOT SO [here] does not read a journey's move.)
